title: Concierge
description:
Somos uma EdTech com foco em processos de saúde. Temos o compromisso de melhorar a educação médica do Brasil, com o propósito de melhorar o cuidado ao paciente em todos os níveis de acesso do sistema de saúde. Somos também um time que acredita a inovação e a tecnologia devem ser aliadas da educação em um meio que está em constante atualizações, por isso, estamos cada vez mais ampliando as oportunidades de talentos na equipe, com desejo de transformar, melhorar e ativamente criar este ecossistema conosco.


Responsabilidades:

  • Realizar atendimento via chat ou outras plataformas de comunicação;
  • Auxiliar os clientes com dúvidas ou problemas técnicos relacionados ao produto, ou serviço;
  • Compreender a solicitação do cliente e atendê-la de forma ágil e solicita;
  • Responder reclamações no site do Reclame Aqui;
  • Realizar onboarding com novos alunos;
  • Realizar chamada de vídeo com alunos, quando necessário para explicar/apresentar a plataforma.


Requisitos:

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Experiência anterior em atendimento ao cliente;
  • Habilidade de comunicação clara, tanto escrita quanto verbal;
  • Facilidade em utilizar sistemas de atendimento e ferramentas de gestão de chamados;
  • Capacidade de solucionar problemas de forma rápida e eficaz, mantendo a calma em situações desafiadoras;
  • Empatia e paciência para lidar com diferentes perfis de clientes;
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Proatividade, vontade de aprender e se desenvolver;
  • Conhecimento básico de informática (Excel).


Desejável:

  • Curso ou experiência com Customer Experience (CX) e/ou Customer Success (CS).

title: Construction Estimator
description:
BIM Estimator – (Mechanical Systems)



About ICON-BIM

ICON-BIM is a 100% U.S.-based, union BIM/VDC specialty contractor located in Federal Way, WA. We provide buildable, field-ready solutions for HVAC and plumbing projects across commercial, healthcare, industrial, and infrastructure sectors. Our team is made up of experienced trade professionals who bring real-world construction knowledge into every model to help projects run smarter, faster, and with fewer surprises. Our team is growing, and we are looking for a driven BIM Estimator – (Mechanical Systems) to join us in supporting project pursuits and delivering accurate, competitive, and timely estimates.


Position Summary

The Estimator will be responsible for preparing detailed cost estimates for union and non- union wet and dry trades—specifically HVAC, plumbing, and mechanical systems. This role requires strong trade knowledge, labor cost analysis, and the ability to leverage BIM/VDC tools to ensure precise and reliable estimating. The successful candidate will bridge their hands-on understanding of the trades with digital construction workflows to help ICON-BIM deliver best-in-class solutions.



Key Responsibilities

• Review project drawings, BIM models, and specifications to develop detailed estimates for HVAC, plumbing, and mechanical system scopes.

• Perform model-based and 2D quantity takeoffs for piping, ductwork, and associated systems.

• Analyze labor (union agreements, open-shop rates, production rates), materials, and equipment costs to generate accurate and competitive bids.

• Maintain and update labor rates, production benchmarks, and historical cost data.

• Support proposal development, including scope narratives, clarifications, and alternatives.

• Partner with project managers and leadership on budgets, bid reviews, and change- order evaluations.



Mandatory Qualifications

• Experience: 3–5+ years of estimating experience in HVAC, plumbing, and mechanical systems, preferably with a background in VDC/BIM environments.

• Trade Knowledge: Strong understanding of wet/dry systems including ductwork, hydronic piping, plumbing fixtures, and mechanical equipment installation.

• Software: Proficiency with BIM/VDC tools (Revit, Navisworks, Fabrication CADmep), estimating/takeoff software (Bluebeam, or similar), and Microsoft Excel.

• Skills: Excellent analytical, organizational, and communication skills with attention to detail.



Desirable Qualifications

• Prior field experience in HVAC, plumbing, or mechanical systems before moving into estimating or BIM coordination.

• Labor Knowledge: Familiarity with collective bargaining agreements, jurisdictional rules, and/or non-union labor costing.

title: PLM Windchill Developer
description:
Job Description:

We are seeking an experienced PLM Solution Specialist with strong expertise in PTC Windchill and ideally Dassault Systèmes 3DExperience (3DX) to support and optimize enterprise Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) initiatives. The role requires a blend of technical configuration, business process leadership, and cross-functional collaboration to deliver scalable PLM solutions aligned with business objectives.

Ideally, we would like to find professionals with knowledge and experience in both Windchill and 3DX . However, if one candidate is strong in Windchill and another is focused on 3DX, we will also consider this combination.

Key Responsibilities

PLM Systems Configuration & Support

  • Customize and configure Windchill and/or 3DX to meet company-specific requirements.
  • Build, update, and manage product data structures to support design and engineering teams.
  • Set up and improve change management processes (change requests, notices, approvals).
  • Configure and automate approval workflows for efficiency and compliance.
  • Modify and support lifecycle steps (draft, concept, design, released) to match internal business processes.
  • Integrate Windchill with SAP and other enterprise applications for design data management.
  • Suggest improvements for product data/document release processes, managing changes via JIRA.
  • Support system upgrades, testing, and technical improvements across global teams.

Business & Functional Leadership

  • Lead business and functional resources in the design of efficient enterprise business processes that leverage PLM solutions.
  • Facilitate workshops and working sessions to gather requirements, demonstrate software functions, or resolve issues.
  • Provide PLM application expertise to stakeholders for roadmap planning and technology evaluation.
  • Collaborate with the PLM Support team to ensure alignment on solution direction and strategy.
  • Provide high-level solution guidance and act as a change agent to drive adoption.
  • Perform cost-benefit analysis, define metrics, and track progress toward business objectives.
  • Develop standards, processes, procedures, and training materials to support PLM usage and adoption.
  • Analyze and revise existing systems and documentation to identify remediation or improvements.

Stakeholder & Relationship Management

  • Act as a trusted advisor with strong customer interfacing skills to communicate solution approaches.
  • Build and maintain relationships across business units, vendors, and technical teams.
  • Influence stakeholders, build support for PLM initiatives, and manage constructive tension when needed.
  • Lead design-related workshops, drive issue resolution, and ensure alignment across functions.

Qualifications & Skills

  • 5+ years’ experience in PLM products, including at least 3 years in PTC Windchill and 2 years in Dassault Systèmes 3DExperience .
  • 6+ years of system analysis and design experience , including enterprise-level application solutions (multi-tier, client/server, database, or web-based).
  • Experience with full software development lifecycle (SDLC) and formal project management methodologies.
  • Functional expertise in PLM applications ; technical domain knowledge is a plus.
  • Experience with Windchill 13 preferred.
  • Knowledge of BOM Views, MPMLink, Variant Configuration, Options and Variants highly desirable.
  • Familiarity with other PTC tools (Creo Parametric, Creo View, Integrity, ThingWorx) beneficial.
  • Experience extending the digital thread upstream/downstream from PLM an advantage.
  • Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into functional specifications.
  • Willingness to learn, recommend, and apply new technologies.

title: Global Feasibility Lead II
description:
Job Overview

The Global Feasibility Lead II will play an integral role in operational strategy and planning in the preaward space through participation in strategy development conversations, robust primary and secondary data collection and analysis, and development of feasibility and site selection strategies. In addition, the Global Feasibility Lead II will be responsible for managing global feasibility projects, working closely with representatives within the company to deliver robust feasibility reports to our customers. The Global Feasibility Lead II will transition the site selection strategy to operations in the post-award space by handing over relevant pre-award findings to the site selection team. The Global Feasibility Lead II will lead and/or contribute to process improvement and change initiatives within Feasibility, alongside training opportunities for departmental requirements and any other subjects that impact on feasibility conduct. The Global Feasibility Lead 2 role requires a diverse skill set; strong data mining and analytics skills, writing and presentation skills, and customer management skills are required. Comfort with participating in and/or leading client facing interactions as it relates to presenting feasibility related findings and recommendations is necessary.


Summary Of Responsibilities

  • Accountable for supporting the development, analyses, interpretation, and presentation of primary and secondary data in support of operational strategy and planning.
  • Conducts data mining of internal and external databases and initiates/oversees the collection of primary data for use in development of robust strategies for global clinical trials (country/site mix, site selection, enrollment modeling.).
  • Participates in the development of proposals and bid defenses; provides recommendations on the most appropriate use of data to support proposals and bid defense presentations, works with the team to identify potential risks, and is learning to propose effective solutions as appropriate.
  • Actively participates on cross-functional teams that plan, analyze, and present proposals and bid defenses as part of winning new business and maintaining client base.
  • Serves as functional bidder reviewer of the budget and text for proposals for which feasibility and/or site identification is included as the primary deliverable.
  • Leads cross functional teams in standalone feasibility efforts; responsible for final report creation and delivery, including discussion of findings and recommendations with external clients.
  • Participates in intra and inter-departmental meetings, leading/contributing to the presentation of information on feasibility offerings, demonstrating continued value-add of the department and providing training on best practices, processes and tools.
  • Develops networking abilities and has an ability/willingness to work with individuals across the globe.
  • Leads and/or contributes to process improvement or special projects within Feasibility.
  • Lead and/or contributes to development, implementation, and maintenance of systems within Feasibility.
  • Contributes to best practice for feasibility conduct.
  • Mentors junior team members (GFL1 or newer GFL2s as needed)
  • And all other duties as needed or assigned.


Qualifications (Minimum Required)

  • Associate degree with equivalent work experience.
  • Practical experience and understanding of global drug development and clinical trials including demonstrated experience for the mining, manipulating, and presenting of complex scientific data as it relates to clinical research and market analyses.


Experience (Minimum Required)

  • Candidates should have at least 4 years of working experience in an academic, science/health-related industry and at least 2 years of relevant experience in clinical research or a science/health-related industry. An associate degree is required; a master’s degree in a science-related discipline is preferred.
  • Position specific requirements:
  • Strong data mining and analytical skills.
  • Strong writing and presentation skills.
  • Upholds the highest standard of personal professionalism and work integrity.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently.
  • Strong attention to detail/quality control skills.
  • Ability to successfully and quickly understand scientific information so as to be able to independently source data/information relevant to a scientific/medical strategy.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with team members, management, operations staff, clients, and executive management.
  • Demonstrated ability to handle multiple competing priorities effectively.
  • Negotiation and relationship management skills.
  • Experience in analyzing study and investigator performance metrics.
  • Self-motivated, works effectively under pressure.
  • Technical Requirements:
  • Excellent computer skills, including strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office and other data capture and compilation tools.
  • Established knowledge of tools used in obtaining critical market analyses of therapeutic pipelines.
  • Strong skills in scientific data manipulation, analysis, reporting, and maintenance.
  • Proven written and verbal communication skills, with strengths in independently gathering/presenting data in support of operational strategy and planning.

Learn more about our EEO & Accommodations request here.

  • Participates in intra and inter-departmental meetings, leading/contributing to the presentation of information on feasibility offerings, demonstrating continued value-add of the department and providing training on best practices, processes and tools.
  • Develops networking abilities and has an ability/willingness to work with individuals across the globe.
  • Leads and/or contributes to process improvement or special projects within Feasibility.
  • Lead and/or contributes to development, implementation, and maintenance of systems within Feasibility.
  • Contributes to best practice for feasibility conduct.
  • Mentors junior team members (GFL1 or newer GFL2s as needed)
  • And all other duties as needed or assigned.


Qualifications (Minimum Required)

  • Associate degree with equivalent work experience.
  • Practical experience and understanding of global drug development and clinical trials including demonstrated experience for the mining, manipulating, and presenting of complex scientific data as it relates to clinical research and market analyses.


Experience (Minimum Required)

  • Candidates should have at least 4 years of working experience in an academic, science/health-related industry and at least 2 years of relevant experience in clinical research or a science/health-related industry. An associate degree is required; a master’s degree in a science-related discipline is preferred.
  • Position specific requirements:
  • Strong data mining and analytical skills.
  • Strong writing and presentation skills.
  • Upholds the highest standard of personal professionalism and work integrity.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently.
  • Strong attention to detail/quality control skills.
  • Ability to successfully and quickly understand scientific information so as to be able to independently source data/information relevant to a scientific/medical strategy.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with team members, management, operations staff, clients, and executive management.
  • Demonstrated ability to handle multiple competing priorities effectively.
  • Negotiation and relationship management skills.
  • Experience in analyzing study and investigator performance metrics.
  • Self-motivated, works effectively under pressure.
  • Technical Requirements:
  • Excellent computer skills, including strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office and other data capture and compilation tools.
  • Established knowledge of tools used in obtaining critical market analyses of therapeutic pipelines.
  • Strong skills in scientific data manipulation, analysis, reporting, and maintenance.
  • Proven written and verbal communication skills, with strengths in independently gathering/presenting data in support of operational strategy and planning.

title: Content Writer
description:
Job Description:

We are seeking highly analytical and detail-oriented professionals with hands-on experience in Red Teaming, Prompt Evaluation , and AI/LLM Quality Assurance . The ideal candidate will help us rigorously test and evaluate AI-generated content to identify vulnerabilities, assess risks, and ensure compliance with safety, ethical, and quality standards.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct Red Teaming exercises to identify adversarial, harmful, or unsafe outputs from large language models (LLMs).
  • Evaluate and stress-test AI prompts across multiple domains (e.g., finance, healthcare, security) to uncover potential failure modes.
  • Develop and apply test cases to assess accuracy, bias, toxicity, hallucinations , and misuse potential in AI-generated responses.
  • Collaborate with data scientists, safety researchers, and prompt engineers to report risks and suggest mitigations.
  • Perform manual QA and content validation across model versions, ensuring factual consistency, coherence, and guideline adherence.
  • Create evaluation frameworks and scoring rubrics for prompt performance and safety compliance.
  • Document findings, edge cases, and vulnerability reports with high clarity and structure.


Requirements:

  • Proven experience in AI red teaming , LLM safety testing, or adversarial prompt design.
  • Familiarity with prompt engineering , NLP tasks, and ethical considerations in generative AI.
  • Strong background in Quality Assurance , content review, or test case development for AI/ML systems.
  • Understanding of LLM behaviors, failure modes, and model evaluation metrics.
  • Excellent critical thinking, pattern recognition, and analytical writing skills.
  • Ability to work independently, follow detailed evaluation protocols, and meet tight deadlines.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior work with teams like OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, or other LLM safety initiatives.
  • Experience in risk assessment, red team security testing, or AI policy & governance.

Background in linguistics, psychology, or computational ethics is a plus.


Next Steps

To proceed further in the evaluation process, you will need to complete two assessments:

  • Assessment Test
  • Evaluates your linguistic and analytical skills
  • Link:



  • Versant English Proficiency Test
  • Focuses on assessing your spoken and written English proficiency
  • A C1 or C2 level is required to qualify


Once both assessments are successfully completed, you will be eligible for onboarding.

  • Language test


Action Required: XConnect Registration

You will also receive an invitation to our internal job platform, XConnect . Please take a few minutes to register and complete your profile. All project onboarding, communication, and documentation are managed through this platform.


If interested, kindly share your resume at:

description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for SAP MM/DRC- S/4HANA,Remote mode who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Must Have

Functional experience with SAP MM, integration with other application, Brazilian SAP Localization knowledge, NFe knowledge and enhancements to supply processes specially with SAP DRC, Experience with Project, Upgrade, Implementation and Rollout Projects. Experience with SAP DRC inbound.


Good to Have

Experience working with multiple teams in different regions.

Experience with SAP DRC outbound.

SAP S/4HANA Rise experience.

As a Functional Consultant, will be responsible for work in Blueprint requitements, back to standard on SAP Localization main topics for Brazil, SAP Customizing/Settings, SAP Notes support to Basis and ABAP team, Unit testing execution, Business and User Acceptance testing support, Transition of requirements to customer stakeholders, key users training, Hypercare/stabilization support (+7yrs experience).

As a Functional Consultant, will be responsible for resolving any SAP issues reported by the business users and delivering all enhancements and upgrade issues as required by business users.

Lead the end-to-end implementation of SAP DRC NF-e projects, including requirement gathering, configuration, testing, and deployment.

Customize and optimize SAP DRC solutions to ensure seamless electronic invoicing (NF-e) compliance in Brazil or other supported jurisdictions.

Ensure accurate integration of SAP DRC with external systems, including government tax portals and legacy systems.

Provide subject matter expertise on local tax regulations and compliance requirements for e-invoicing.

Identify risks and proactively develop mitigation strategies during the project lifecycle.

Conduct user training, support issue resolution, and provide go-live assistance.

Maintain documentation for processes, configurations, and project changes.

Responsible for completing all tasks assigned by team lead and project manager.

Responsible for reviewing solutions designed by the team members and proposing improvements.

Responsible for proactively working with business users for identifying and resolving recurring issues.

Experience in a Professional Consumers and package (CPG) company is an asset.

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

title: Salesforce Data Cloud Consultant
description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.


The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves.


Data Cloud Consultant

Skills:

It is desirable that the candidate has a Salesforce Certified Data Cloud Consultant certification, and should have experience in implementing and consulting on enterprise data platforms in a customer-facing role, including design, configuration, and solution architecture.


Recommendation:

Experience in implementing and working with strategy and data modeling, including building multiple solutions on Salesforce clouds.

- Have experience in development, strategy, business analysis, pre-sales solutions, or architecture.


Job Description:

Responsible for conducting customer discussions around requirements and technical drawing.

Development of software programs by technical specifications following programming standards and procedures, performing unit tests, performing program modifications and responding to problems by diagnosing and correcting logic and coding errors.

Ensure that secure coding and UI standards and best practices are applied during development.

Provide inputs and contribute to the improvement and maintenance of applications and programs.

Leading efforts to configure, analyze, design, develop, and maintain program code and applications.

Execution of detailed and complex unit tests and secure code testing and troubleshooting.

Conducting and supporting the source code management process.

Contributing to integration, systems and performance testing and code tuning.

Participation in secure code peer reviews.

Definition and promotion of opportunities for the reuse of code, configurations, procedures and techniques.


Requirements:

Degrees in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field are preferred.

Fluency in English to conduct technical meetings with offshore team, support teams and customers outside Brazil.

Experience with Data Architecture

Experience in writing SQL queries and data modeling, as well as governance and architecture performance practice and guidelines

Proficient in migrating data from traditional applications to Salesforce using the Import Wizard and Data Loader utility

Experienced in handling multi-country deployments and managing multiple instances of Salesforce.com

Experience with setting up and customizing managed Field Service packages is a plus.

Solution Modeling - Creates, designs, and formulates models, diagrams, and documentation using IT processes, standards, tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance, and compliance requirements.

Data Modeling - Creates, writes, and tests data models, test scripts, and build scripts using IT processes, patterns, and tools, version control, and automation

Performance tuning - Conceptualizes, analyzes, and resolves application, database, and hardware issues using IT processes, standards, and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance, and compliance requirements.

Solution Validation Testing - Validates a configuration item or solution change using the IT Operating Model (ITOM), including SDLC standards, tools, and metrics, to ensure that it works as designed and meets customer requirements.

Customer Focus - Building strong customer relationships and providing customer-centric solutions.

Manages complexity – Understanding complex, high-quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to solve problems effectively.

Global perspective – Take a broad view when addressing issues, using a global lens.

Action-oriented – Taking on new opportunities and difficult challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Optimizes work processes – Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.


Skills:

Knowledge of service-oriented design (SOA) principles.

Excellent oral, presentation and written communication skills.

Good interpersonal skills.

Extensive knowledge of Salesforce technology and specifically the data cloud and its features and terminologies;

Experience in positioning and implementing Salesforce Data Cloud.

Salesforce Data Cloud certifications will be a plus for this role.

Proven experience in implementation and consulting of Salesforce Data Cloud environments.


At HCLTech, we don’t just offer jobs — we offer journeys. Join a global team where your work drives innovation, your ideas matter, and your growth is supported every step of the way.


Why Choose HCLTech?

  • Be part of a purpose-led organization with a global footprint
  • Collaborate with diverse teams across borders
  • Work on cutting-edge technologies in enterprise integration
  • Enjoy career mobility, continuous learning, and a culture of inclusion

Experience in writing SQL queries and data modeling, as well as governance and architecture performance practice and guidelines

Proficient in migrating data from traditional applications to Salesforce using the Import Wizard and Data Loader utility

Experienced in handling multi-country deployments and managing multiple instances of Salesforce.com

Experience with setting up and customizing managed Field Service packages is a plus.

Solution Modeling - Creates, designs, and formulates models, diagrams, and documentation using IT processes, standards, tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance, and compliance requirements.

Data Modeling - Creates, writes, and tests data models, test scripts, and build scripts using IT processes, patterns, and tools, version control, and automation

Performance tuning - Conceptualizes, analyzes, and resolves application, database, and hardware issues using IT processes, standards, and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance, and compliance requirements.

Solution Validation Testing - Validates a configuration item or solution change using the IT Operating Model (ITOM), including SDLC standards, tools, and metrics, to ensure that it works as designed and meets customer requirements.

Customer Focus - Building strong customer relationships and providing customer-centric solutions.

Manages complexity – Understanding complex, high-quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to solve problems effectively.

Global perspective – Take a broad view when addressing issues, using a global lens.

Action-oriented – Taking on new opportunities and difficult challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Optimizes work processes – Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.


Skills:

Knowledge of service-oriented design (SOA) principles.

Excellent oral, presentation and written communication skills.

Good interpersonal skills.

Extensive knowledge of Salesforce technology and specifically the data cloud and its features and terminologies;

Experience in positioning and implementing Salesforce Data Cloud.

Salesforce Data Cloud certifications will be a plus for this role.

Proven experience in implementation and consulting of Salesforce Data Cloud environments.

title: Líder de Projetos SAP SD SR - Reforma tributária - Inglês Avançado/Fluente
description:
Sobre a empresa

Somos a SEIDOR, multinacional de tecnologia e inovação, que oferece um portfólio completo de soluções e serviços para promover a competitividade e a transformação das organizações. São mais de 40 anos acreditando na tecnologia , com 85 escritórios e uma equipe de mais de 7.500 profissionais na Europa, América Latina, Estados Unidos, África, Oriente Médio e Ásia.


Somos parceiros platinum da SAP e temos mais de 8.500 clientes . Nosso portfólio completo é voltado para empresas grandes, médias e em crescimento. Na SEIDOR acreditamos que, para enfrentar os novos desafios do mundo digital, devemos ter os melhores aliados, as tecnologias líderes de mercado e, acima de tudo, as melhores pessoas.


Nós acreditamos no valor das pessoas . Buscamos constantemente atrair e reter talentos, investindo no desenvolvimento de nossos colaboradores e oferecendo oportunidades de crescimento profissional. Nosso time é composto por profissionais colaborativos, autônomos e ágeis que juntos formam um ambiente de trabalho desafiador, dinâmico e sem discriminação, respeitando as diferenças que nos tornam mais humanos.


✨ Venha fazer parte desse novo projeto! ✨

Tem os requisitos abaixo? Então essa vaga é para você ! ✨

  • Líder de Projetos SAP SD SR - Reforma tributária - Inglês Avançado/Fluente


Sobre a oportunidade:

  • Início: Assim que aprovado
  • Prazo: Indeterminado, fazer parte do time da consultoria
  • Atividades: Liderar e coordenar projetos de Reforma Tributária SAP SD e demais iniciativas estratégicas, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos de negócio e prazos
  • Atuar como ponto focal entre delivery e fábrica SAP
  • Apoiar equipes multidisciplinares, oferecendo direcionamento, suporte técnico e liderança motivacional
  • Apoiar na priorização e alocação de recursos em cenários de múltiplas demandas concorrentes
  • Realizar a comunicação com áreas de negócio e stakeholders, assegurando entendimento dos impactos, riscos e status dos projetos
  • Garantir a documentação adequada dos projetos, cumprindo com processos de governança e compliance
  • Atuar com agilidade em demandas emergenciais, apoiando soluções críticas quando necessário
  • Participar de fóruns de projetos, planejamento de capacidade e alinhamento estratégico com áreas de negócio


Requisitos:

  • Experiência em projetos de grande porte e abrangência global
  • Inglês Avançado/Fluente
  • Conhecimento de processos fiscais, RH ou supply chain em contexto SAP
  • Vivência com gestão de portfólio de projetos e planejamento de capacidade de recursos
  • Conhecimento funcional SAP (Fiscal, RH, Distribuição, Finance, Controladoria, Inbound, Outbound)


Desejável:

  • DRC Outbound

title: Arquiteto de Software Sênior
description:
Posição: Arquiteto de Software Sênior


Responsabilidades

  • Analisar o cenário atual (AS-IS) e definir a visão futura de arquitetura (TO-BE).
  • Definir e documentar padrões de arquitetura, microsserviços e APIs.
  • Projetar infraestrutura cloud (Kubernetes, API Gateway, service mesh).
  • Liderar governança de arquitetura e processos de CI/CD.
  • Garantir atributos de qualidade (segurança, performance, escalabilidade).
  • Atuar como mentor técnico de desenvolvedores e tech leads.


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida em microsserviços (desenho, implantação, padrões: Saga, CQRS, Circuit Breaker).
  • Domínio de PHP (Symfony) e/ou Java (Spring Boot).
  • Experiência com frontend (preferencialmente Angular) e design de APIs REST/GraphQL.
  • Vivência em cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP) e containers (Kubernetes como diferencial).
  • Forte conhecimento em CI/CD (GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions) e IaC (Terraform/CloudFormation).


Diferenciais

  • Migração de monólito para microsserviços.
  • Monitoramento/observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, New Relic).
  • Segurança (OWASP, APIs, identity providers).
  • Experiência em EdTech.

description:

title: Gerente de vendas
description:
A Zoomlion Brasil, multinacional com forte atuação global nos segmentos de máquinas pesadas para construção civil e agricultura, está com processo seletivo aberto para a posição de Gerente de Vendas no Brasil.


Esta é uma oportunidade estratégica para profissionais com sólida experiência no setor, perfil de liderança e visão comercial orientada a resultados.


Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar a equipe nacional de vendas, promovendo o desenvolvimento comercial dos profissionais;
  • Definir estratégias comerciais alinhadas ao posicionamento global da empresa e às demandas do mercado brasileiro;
  • Gerenciar metas, indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e relatórios de performance;
  • Identificar oportunidades de expansão de mercado e novos canais de distribuição;
  • Atuar diretamente na negociação com grandes contas e parceiros estratégicos;
  • Representar a empresa em feiras, eventos e visitas institucionais, mantendo relacionamento próximo com clientes e stakeholders.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Ensino superior completo (Administração, Engenharia, ou áreas correlatas);
  • Inglês avançado (interações frequentes com a matriz e equipes globais);
  • Experiência comprovada na função de gerência comercial em empresas do segmento de máquinas pesadas (construção civil e/ou agrícola);
  • Histórico de liderança de equipes comerciais e gestão de territórios nacionais;
  • Conhecimento do mercado brasileiro, canais de distribuição e estratégias de penetração comercial.

title: Arquiteto Salesforce
description:
Alô LinkedIn! Estamos com vagas disponíveis para você na TAAK!


Estamos em busca de um Arquiteto Salesforce para integrar nosso time e liderar a definição de soluções estratégicas dentro da plataforma. Se você gosta de desafios, tem visão sistêmica e experiência em arquitetar soluções complexas em Salesforce, essa oportunidade é para você!


Arquiteto Salesforce

Responsabilidades:

  • Desenhar e definir arquiteturas escaláveis e seguras na plataforma Salesforce.
  • Traduzir requisitos de negócios em soluções técnicas eficientes.
  • Atuar como referência técnica para desenvolvedores e consultores, orientando o time em boas práticas e padrões de desenvolvimento.
  • Garantir a integração do Salesforce com sistemas externos e internos.
  • Avaliar impactos técnicos de novas implementações e releases da plataforma.
  • Conduzir revisões de código, arquitetura e governança de projetos Salesforce.


Requisitos:

  • Formação em áreas relacionadas à tecnologia (Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou afins).
  • Experiência comprovada como Arquiteto Salesforce em projetos de médio a grande porte.
  • Domínio de Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components (LWC) e arquitetura de integrações.
  • Experiência sólida em integrações via APIs REST/SOAP, middleware e padrões de integração.
  • Conhecimento de práticas de segurança e governança no ecossistema Salesforce.
  • Certificações Salesforce relevantes (como Application Architect, System Architect, Technical Architect e/ou Data Architect ) serão um diferencial significativo.


Diferenciais:

  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis e práticas DevOps aplicadas ao Salesforce.
  • Experiência com CI/CD, automação de deploys e gerenciamento de versionamento.
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de soluções omnichannel e Customer 360.
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de traduzir aspectos técnicos para stakeholders não técnicos.
  • Experiência em liderança técnica de times Salesforce.


Processo Seletivo:

1️⃣ Registration

2️⃣ Triagem

3️⃣ Entrevista técnica 1

4️⃣ Entrevista técnica 2

5️⃣ Proposta

title: Gerente Operacional Fulfillment
description:
VAGA HIGH LEVEL


Estamos buscando um profissional com experiência comprovada em gerenciamento de operações de fulfillment em empresas de E-commerce. Domínio TOTAL de SHOPIFY , mente analítica e sede por resultado!


Necessário:

  • Sólidos conhecimentos em sistemas de gestão de armazém e otimização das operações para garantir a velocidade de processamento de pedidos na Shopify .
  • Capacidade demonstrada em gerenciamento de equipes, flexibilidade , adaptabilidade e interligação com as áreas de compras no gerenciamento de estoque;
  • Conhecimentos em análise de dados e uso de indicadores para medição do desempenho e identificação de áreas de melhoria;
  • Liderança, comunicação efetiva e habilidades de tomada de decisão são qualidades essenciais para o cargo.


Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar as operações de fulfillment, garantindo a eficiência e eficácia no processamento e rápida entrega dos pedidos;
  • Implementar e gerenciar sistemas de gestão dos armazéns na Europa para otimizar as operações e reduzir os custos;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipes de compras para garantir a gestão eficiente do estoque;
  • Analisar dados e indicadores para identificar tendências, problemas e oportunidades de melhoria, agilizando o processo operacional interno , direcionando gestores de Armazéns e garantindo entrega rápida para nossos clientes;
  • Desenvolver e implementar processos e procedimentos para garantir a qualidade e a segurança nas operações de logística e fulfillment.

title: Power BI Developer
description:
One of our leading client is looking for Power BI Developer


Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop, publish, and schedule Power BI dashboards and reports as per business requirements.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into scalable BI solutions.
  • Perform data modeling, data transformation, and DAX scripting for complex calculations.
  • Ensure the accuracy, reliability, and performance optimization of Power BI solutions.
  • Work with SQL databases, ETL processes, and other data sources to integrate and transform data.
  • Maintain data security, governance, and compliance within BI solutions.
  • Provide technical support, troubleshooting, and training to business users.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.
  • Proven experience as a Power BI Developer (3+ years preferred).
  • Strong expertise in Power BI Desktop, Power BI Service, and DAX .
  • Solid understanding of data modeling, ETL processes, and relational databases .
  • Proficiency in SQL and querying large datasets.
  • Experience integrating Power BI with multiple data sources (Excel, SQL Server, Azure, APIs, etc.).
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and presentation skills.
  • Knowledge of Azure Data services (Data Factory, Synapse, Databricks) is a plus.
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies and DevOps practices is an advantage.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Summary

We’re looking for a DevOps Engineer to help us build and scale the foundation behind cutting-edge immersive entertainment experiences. You will play a key role in shaping our infrastructure-as-code, streamlining deployments, and ensuring our systems are secure, observable, and resilient. If you enjoy working with modern cloud technologies, container orchestration, and automation in a dynamic environment, we’d love to hear from you.


Core Requirements

- Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code using Pulumi (TypeScript) .

- Strong understanding of AWS services (IAM, VPC, S3, EC2, EKS, security groups).

- Solid knowledge of Kubernetes fundamentals (pods, services, deployments, ingress).

- Experience with CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions.

- Familiarity with containerization using Docker and deployment workflows with Helm , Kustomize , and FluxCD .

- Understanding of networking concepts (DNS, load balancers, ingress controllers) and securely integrating managed services (e.g., MongoDB Atlas) with Kubernetes.

- Proven experience in monitoring and observability with Grafana, Loki, and Prometheus.


Nice to Have

- Experience with build & release management for TypeScript and/or Rust applications.


Other Traits

- Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.

- Ability to work in cross-functional teams with engineers from multiple disciplines.

- Passion for automation, scalability, and infrastructure best practices.

title: Developer Frontend
description:
Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.

Estamos com uma oportunidade para o nosso time corporativo para: Developer Frontend


Experiência Profissional


  • Participar do design de UI, design técnico e revisões de código.
  • Detalhar e fornecer escopo técnico para histórias e épicos em sprints de 2 semanas.
  • Escrever código frontend de alta qualidade, performático e reutilizável para o UX dos produtos do cliente.
  • Escrever testes unitários e de integração que comprovem que o código atende aos critérios de aceitação.
  • Experiência com NextJS ou outro framework React.
  • Forte interesse em criar experiências de usuário agradáveis e intuitivas.
  • Experiência com frameworks de testes como Jest e JUnit.
  • Conhecimento prático de tecnologias backend como Java Spring Boot, Node e desenvolvimento de APIs baseadas em REST.
  • Conhecimento de arquitetura web e do protocolo HTTP.
  • Compreensão de arquitetura de microsserviços.
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento MVC.
  • Conhecimento de estratégias de cache.
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento em nuvem.
  • Familiaridade com Jenkins e ambientes de CI/CD.
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de software internacionalizado.
  • Experiência em integração e configuração de CMS, CDP, gerenciadores de tags, analytics de marketing e outras tecnologias MarTech.


Conhecimento Técnico


  • Forte conhecimento de tecnologias modernas de JavaScript, como Angular, React e Typescript
  • Forte conhecimento de HTML, CSS/LESS/SASS.
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de interfaces responsivas para web e mobile.
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de aplicações web.
  • Bacharelado ou Mestrado em Ciência da Computação ou área técnica relacionada.


Formação Acadêmica


  • Bacharelado ou Mestrado em Ciência da Computação ou área técnica relacionada.


Idioma


  • Inglês - Fluente


Modalidade: PJ (6 meses com possibilidade de de efetivação)


Benefício: 30 dias de descanso remunerado


Todas as nossas oportunidades de trabalho estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Program Manager
description:
At Brightdome, we don’t just build digital solutions; we partner with businesses to set the pace of digital greatness. Our mission is to become the world’s most trusted partner in this journey, and we’re looking for an exceptional Program Manager to be at the heart of our client’s success.


The Opportunity


As a Program Manager , you are the conductor of our most critical client engagements. You don’t just manage timelines; you orchestrate complex projects from concept to flawless execution, ensuring we deliver extraordinary value every step of the way. This is a hands-on role for someone who loves being in the center of the action and making things happen.


You will:

  • Own the end-to-end delivery of ambitious, complex digital projects.
  • Serve as the trusted, central point of contact for our clients, building strong partnerships founded on clarity and results.
  • Empower our cross-functional teams by removing roadblocks and fostering a collaborative environment.
  • Proactively anticipate risks and solve problems before they impact the project.
  • Be the engine of execution that keeps everything on time, within scope, and on budget.



Who You Are


We are looking for someone who is driven by a deep sense of ownership and a passion for excellence.

  • You are a master of project management and a natural expeditor; you don’t wait for things to happen, you make them happen.
  • You have an obsessive eye for quality and detail, ensuring nothing short of excellence reaches our clients.
  • You are a phenomenal communicator and a natural organizer. You bring clarity to complexity and build effortless rapport with everyone from engineers to executives.
  • You thrive in a remote, autonomous environment, demonstrating incredible self-discipline and a proactive, entrepreneurial spirit.
  • You have 5+ years of experience successfully delivering complex projects in a client-facing role.
  • A bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field is a strong foundation for this role.



Why Brightdome?


We believe in impact over instruction. At Brightdome, you are a true partner in our mission. We hire talented people and give them the freedom and context to do their best work. We value candor, collaboration, and a relentless drive to find innovative solutions that deliver outsized results for our clients.If this sounds like you, we’d love to talk.

title: Representante de Propaganda Médica
description:
Na Exeltis, acreditamos no poder da conexão e do conhecimento para transformar vidas.


Estamos em busca de Representante de Propaganda Médica com paixão por impactar positivamente a jornada das pacientes, por meio de um relacionamento próximo com médicos e farmácias.

Se você tem energia, atitude protagonista, foco em resultados e deseja crescer em um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, essa oportunidade é para você!


Local de atuação: Salvador – BA


Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Realizar visitas médicas e em pontos de venda (PDVs) de forma estratégica, promovendo nosso portfólio com excelência.
  • Gerir o painel médico e farmacêutico, mantendo o cadastro sempre atualizado, com foco na geração de demanda qualificada.
  • Planejar roteiros de visita com base em metas e indicadores de performance.
  • Monitorar os resultados das ações em campo e propor estratégias para superação de metas.
  • Organizar e participar de eventos, treinamentos e ações promocionais com médicos e farmácias.
  • Controlar e distribuir amostras grátis de maneira responsável e conforme as normas internas.
  • Realizar lançamentos em sistema e relatórios de visita, contribuindo para a inteligência de mercado.
  • Garantir a presença e a visibilidade dos produtos nos pontos de venda da sua região.
  • Aplicar as estratégias da empresa com base em sólido conhecimento técnico e habilidades de vendas.


Requisitos para brilhar nessa vaga:

  • Ensino superior completo.
  • CNH B ativa.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes.
  • Pacote Office em nível intermediário.
  • Experiência no setor farmacêutico.
  • Residir em: Salvador - BA


Você vai arrasar se tiver:

  • Pós-graduação em áreas relacionadas à saúde ou gestão.
  • Experiência no setor farmacêutico com foco em saúde feminina .
  • Conhecimento em estratégias de demanda e relacionamento.


Habilidades que fazem a diferença:

  • Foco em resultados, com forte orientação para metas.
  • Excelente comunicação e poder de argumentação.
  • Organização, disciplina e proatividade.
  • Capacidade de análise de dados e identificação de oportunidades.
  • Espírito de equipe e colaboração.


Se identificou? Venha fazer parte da Família Sangue Azul!

title: Acquisition Editor, Life Science
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role

We are seeking an ambitious individual to join our team as an Acquisition Editor. In this role, you will focus on recruiting new authors and content for our Journal.


Responsibilities:

  • Identify and recruit new authors, guiding them through the manuscript submission process for JoVE Journal.
  • Contact potential Guest Editors and collaborate with them to build a Methods Collections, our version of a special issue.
  • Establish and maintain a strong network of scientists/journal authors to drive content acquisition and grow submission rates.
  • Collaborate with the peer review team to facilitate the publication of manuscripts.
  • Meet or exceed monthly acquisition targets.


Requirements:

  • A Ph.D. in the Life Sciences.
  • Fluent English written and verbal communication skills.
  • Results-driven, with an ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational, influencing and problem-solving skills.
  • Familiarity with the publishing process is a plus.


Why Join JoVE?

  • You can expect compensation competitively placed within the local market, including unlimited bonus for manuscript acquisition.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and discovery.
  • Opportunity to work in a remote environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Web Content Editor
description:
****Please attach your ENGLISH resume to be considered

*****Proficiency/Bilingual in English

*** Full time contractor (8 hrs shifts)



Company Description

Bucksense, Inc. is the programmatic platform for advertisers and agencies looking to bring brand building in-house. With a presence in Europe and USA, we are a global team of dedicated people drawn from diverse backgrounds, young and energetic who are passionate about bringing color solutions to the industry we serve. To consistently deliver the highest quality solutions to our clients, we only hire the best talents and nurture their professional growth on exciting projects.


Key Responsibilities


  • Edit, proofread, and publish web content to ensure clarity, grammar, accuracy, and alignment with brand guidelines.
  • Maintain content quality across pages, ensuring consistency in style, formatting, and structure.
  • Collaborate with writers, designers, and developers to produce and update webpages.
  • Optimize content for UX and SEO, including internal linking and accessibility.
  • Manage and update content in a CMS (e.g., Sanity, WordPress, or similar).
  • Monitor website performance and user engagement; recommend improvements based on analytics.
  • Conduct regular content audits to identify outdated or underperforming material.
  • Maintain an editorial calendar and coordinate updates with other departments.


Qualifications & Skills


  • 2+ years of experience in digital content editing or publishing, ideally for travel, lifestyle, luxury, or e-commerce websites.

title: Tech Lead Outsystems
description:
• O que é preciso para fazer parte do time?
  • Requisitos técnicos essenciais:
  • Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento e liderança técnica OutSystems , especialmente em projetos Web e Mobile ;
  • Vivência prática com a versão ODC (OutSystems Developer Cloud) ;
  • Conhecimento sólido em arquitetura de soluções OutSystems , com foco em boas práticas, reutilização e performance;
  • Experiência com integrações via APIs REST/SOAP e conectores externos;
  • Domínio das ferramentas do ecossistema: Service Center, Lifetime, Integration Studio, AI Mentor (ou equivalentes na ODC);
  • Vivência em metodologias ágeis (Scrum ou Kanban).
  • Competências comportamentais:
  • Capacidade de liderar tecnicamente times e apoiar a evolução de colegas;
  • Comunicação clara e assertiva com stakeholders de negócio e tecnologia;
  • Colaboração, escuta ativa e habilidade de transformar problemas complexos em soluções viáveis;
  • Perfil organizado, proativo e com visão de melhoria contínua.

Será um diferencial se você:

  • Conhecimentos adicionais: experiência em cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP) e em integrações complexas;
  • Experiências prévias relevantes: atuação em projetos corporativos de grande escala;
  • Certificações ou formações complementares: certificações OutSystems, especialmente voltadas ao ODC;
  • Soft skills diferenciais: habilidade em mediação de conflitos, gestão de prioridades e visão estratégica de produto;

title: Senior iOS Developer
description:
Dive deep into Digital! For 20 years Intellias has been developing top-tier digital solutions for the world’s leading companies, keeping them in line with the latest technology trends. Join in and provide innovations for the future!


We are looking for a talented Senior iOS (SwiftUI/Combine) Developer, to work remotely from Brazil . The position demands a candidate capable of doing high-quality work against technical and schedule challenges, while following strong software design and process principles. This is a great opportunity to play a key role in a dynamic team, working on cutting edge mobile technology. You are a driver of change and you have yet to meet a technology challenge you cannot resolve. You are dedicated to developing clean code that will help shape the iOS mobile software which thrills Client users.


Requirements:

  • 5+ years of working experience in software engineering
  • Extensive experience developing iOS mobile native applications in Swift/SwiftUI
  • Proven knowledge of Swift programming language
  • Knowledge and experience with SwiftUI and Combine
  • Solid understanding of the full iOS mobile development life cycle
  • Strong knowledge of iOS UI design principles and best practices
  • Experience with at least one of these design architectures: MVVM, MVC, VIPER, Clean (Onion Architecture)
  • Eperience with TCA or other Redux-like architectures
  • Expert in UI layouts and creating adaptive layouts for various hardware configurations
  • Experience writing custom views and controls
  • Experience consuming RESTful JSON/XML web services
  • Experience in testing high volume applications: unit test, integration test, performance test
  • Experience using external commercial and open source libraries
  • Experience with Git and GitFlow
  • A solid grasp of fundamental algorithms, data structures, and design patterns
  • Portfolio of apps that you’ve built; ideally available in the App Store
  • Ability to prototype new features and redesign existing ones
  • Excellent problem solving, debugging skills, critical thinking, and communication skills
  • Ability to effectively articulate technical challenges and solutions
  • Aptitude and desire to independently learn new technologies
  • Advanced level of English, good communication skills.


Preferred Skills:

  • Experience in Core Animation, Core Graphics, Core Bluetooth (Classic, BLE)
  • Experience in automated user interface functional testing
  • Experience with Scrum/Agile methodologies
  • Experience mentoring junior members
  • Experience with iOS performance profiling tools and optimization techniques
  • Experience with Open API standard (Swagger)
  • Experience with push notifications
  • Working knowledge of Internationalization
  • Proficient in Objective-C
  • Experience with UIKit


Responsibilities:

  • Contribute to high quality mobile app design and architecture
  • Apply software engineering design patterns to develop well-structured, modular, performant application code
  • Serve as a technical mentor in mobile app development
  • Perform code reviews, write unit and UI tests, and contribute to architectural planning and refactoring
  • Collaborate with API teams on API design


The contract type for this position is B2B contract .


If you are looking for a challenge like this, submit your application!

title: Content Strategist - Freela
description:
Estamos procurando alguém que pense fora da caixa e transforme ideias em planos de conteúdo cheios de impacto. Se você tem olhar criativo, ama contar histórias e sabe como engajar pessoas nas diferentes plataformas, essa vaga é a sua cara!


Responsabilidades:


  • Criar e tocar o plano de conteúdo da marca.
  • Montar o calendário editorial e pensar em formatos diferentes.
  • Trazer insights criativos e acompanhar tendências.
  • Garantir que o tom de voz da marca seja único e consistente.
  • Analisar resultados e ajustar a rota quando precisar.


O que esperamos de você:


  • Experiência com estratégia e planejamento de conteúdo.
  • Boa escrita e comunicação.
  • Curiosidade, organização e paixão por criatividade.
  • Vontade de inovar e fazer diferente.


Diferenciais: Storytelling e cases criativos no portfólio.

title: 翻译员 - brazil
description:

- 负责将源语言的文本准确、流畅地翻译成目标语言，保持原文的意思和风格，译稿内容准确（月翻译量：约 源英文单词）。

- 熟悉不同产品的专业术语和行业背景，确保翻译内容符合特定领域的要求。

2. 文本审核与本地化：

- 对翻译文档/线上文案进行审核、本地化走查，提高翻译质量和准确性，符合语言表达规范和语境要求。

- 注意语法、拼写、标点等细节，提高文案的专业水平和可读性。

3. 跨文化沟通：

- 具备良好的跨文化沟通能力，理解不同文化背景和习惯，避免翻译中出现的文化歧义和误解。

- 在跨文化交流中发挥积极作用，促进各方之间的理解和合作。

4. 专业知识更新：

- 持续学习和积累相关领域的专业知识和术语，保持对行业发展和变化的敏感度。

- 不断提升翻译技能和语言能力，适应不同领域和语种的翻译需求。

- 自觉积极更新和维护相关产品多语种术语库。

5. 其他工作：

- 积极服从公司及Team Leader的各项安排，以促进团队的顺利运作和项目的顺利推进。

1. 本科及以上学历，语言/翻译等相关专业，巴西葡语为母语，精通英文或中文。

2. 具有一定的翻译工作经验，拥有语言或翻译能力证书优先。

3. 熟练使用CAT工具（Trados，memoQ，Smartling等）。

4. 金融、证券、期货、数字货币交易行业翻译经验优先。

5. 工作认真负责，响应及时，有责任心，有较强的学习能力，良好的沟通协调能力。

title: Cientista de Dados Sênior
description:
Sobre a Vaga:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Data Scientist altamente qualificado(a) e versátil para integrar nossa equipe de analytics avançado. Nesta função, você será responsável por projetar, desenvolver e implementar sistemas de recomendação, modelos de previsão de séries temporais e soluções de machine learning baseadas em algoritmos de boosting e árvores de decisão. Você trabalhará em estreita colaboração com equipes multifuncionais para transformar dados em insights acionáveis e soluções escaláveis.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e otimizar sistemas de recomendação (filtragem colaborativa, baseada em conteúdo, abordagens híbridas).
  • Construir e validar modelos de previsão de séries temporais utilizando técnicas tradicionais e de machine learning (ARIMA, Prophet, LSTM, etc.).
  • Implementar algoritmos de boosting (XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost) e árvores de decisão para diversas tarefas de aprendizado supervisionado.
  • Colaborar com engenheiros de dados e engenheiros de ML para implantar modelos em ambientes Azure e Databricks.
  • Realizar exploração de dados, engenharia de features e avaliação de modelos.
  • Apresentar descobertas e modelos de forma clara para públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre as mais recentes ferramentas e metodologias aplicadas em machine learning.

Requisitos:

  • Graduação ou Mestrado em Ciência de Dados, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Estatística ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência comprovada com sistemas de recomendação e modelos de séries temporais.
  • Sólido conhecimento em algoritmos de boosting e árvores de decisão.
  • Proficiência em Python e bibliotecas como scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, statsmodels.
  • Experiência com serviços em nuvem Azure e Databricks.
  • Forte capacidade de resolução de problemas e habilidade para trabalhar de forma independente.
  • Inglês fluente (oral e escrito).

title: Eletricista Subtransmissão Linha Viva III
description:
Sinta a nossa energia!


Somos um time de 16 mil colaboradores próprios, espalhados por 18 estados brasileiros e no Distrito Federal. Aqui, os sotaques se misturam, integração, colaboração e segurança são elementos fundamentais em nosso dia a dia. Atuamos em toda a cadeia do setor elétrico brasileiro, Geração, Transmissão, Distribuição e Comercialização. Juntos, somos essa Neoenergia toda!

Queremos liderar a transição energética no Brasil e ser a escolha número 1 para brasileiros e brasileiras. E faremos isso com pessoas de todos os gêneros, raças, idades, orientações sexuais e com deficiências. Investimos em diversidade, inovação e tecnologias para oferecer a melhor experiência de soluções energéticas conectadas a cada um dos nossos 16 milhões de clientes!


Sua energia será muito importante para:


Executar as manutenções e operações das linhas de transmissão e subestações do sistema elétrico da Coelba, segundo normas e procedimentos estabelecidos, garantindo a qualidade, confiabilidade, segurança e a continuidade do fornecimento de energia elétrica em todo o estado da Bahia.


Atividades:


Trabalhar em conformidade com procedimentos e manual de conduta;

Executar tarefas de suporte administrativo/de escritório em um ambiente de escritório, campo ou local;

Execução das inspeções visuais, termográficas, manutenções preditivas, preventivas e corretivas nos ativos de subtransmissão;

Garantir a qualidade das intervenções por meio da execução de serviços de manuseio, transporte de carga/descarga de equipamentos e materiais de uso na manutenção.

Assegurar melhorias de qualidade em subestações e linhas por meio do auxílio na execução de obras CAPEX e OPEX nessas instalações.

Reduzir tempo e número de interrupções fortuitas através de serviços de apoio a outras áreas, associados a operação e manutenção em linhas de Subtransmissão e distribuição.

Acompanhamento diário dos registros de eventos de relés digitais e identificação e correção de falhas em ativos de subtransmissão;

Coordenar trabalhos de campo, dirigir viaturas, planejar atividades, interpretar projetos, relatórios e relatórios da ordem de serviço, realizar acompanhamento das obras em campo, orientar sobre risco de acidente, prestar suporte de socorro em caso de acidente, e ou problemas de saúde, realizar integração / DSS com sua equipe;

Elaborar planos operacionais, colaborando com sugestões, fazendo mudanças de funções , delegando atividades e supervisionando o trabalho das equipes;

Desenvolver a sua equipe de maneira a promover o crescimento profissional e intelectual de cada membro.

title: Eletricista Subtransmissão Linha Viva III
description:
Sinta a nossa energia!


Somos um time de 16 mil colaboradores próprios, espalhados por 18 estados brasileiros e no Distrito Federal. Aqui, os sotaques se misturam, integração, colaboração e segurança são elementos fundamentais em nosso dia a dia. Atuamos em toda a cadeia do setor elétrico brasileiro, Geração, Transmissão, Distribuição e Comercialização. Juntos, somos essa Neoenergia toda!

Queremos liderar a transição energética no Brasil e ser a escolha número 1 para brasileiros e brasileiras. E faremos isso com pessoas de todos os gêneros, raças, idades, orientações sexuais e com deficiências. Investimos em diversidade, inovação e tecnologias para oferecer a melhor experiência de soluções energéticas conectadas a cada um dos nossos 16 milhões de clientes!


Sua energia será muito importante para:


Executar as manutenções e operações das linhas de transmissão e subestações do sistema elétrico da Coelba, segundo normas e procedimentos estabelecidos, garantindo a qualidade, confiabilidade, segurança e a continuidade do fornecimento de energia elétrica em todo o estado da Bahia.


Atividades:


Trabalhar em conformidade com procedimentos e manual de conduta;

Executar tarefas de suporte administrativo/de escritório em um ambiente de escritório, campo ou local;

Execução das inspeções visuais, termográficas, manutenções preditivas, preventivas e corretivas nos ativos de subtransmissão;

Garantir a qualidade das intervenções por meio da execução de serviços de manuseio, transporte de carga/descarga de equipamentos e materiais de uso na manutenção.

Assegurar melhorias de qualidade em subestações e linhas por meio do auxílio na execução de obras CAPEX e OPEX nessas instalações.

Reduzir tempo e número de interrupções fortuitas através de serviços de apoio a outras áreas, associados a operação e manutenção em linhas de Subtransmissão e distribuição.

Acompanhamento diário dos registros de eventos de relés digitais e identificação e correção de falhas em ativos de subtransmissão;

Coordenar trabalhos de campo, dirigir viaturas, planejar atividades, interpretar projetos, relatórios e relatórios da ordem de serviço, realizar acompanhamento das obras em campo, orientar sobre risco de acidente, prestar suporte de socorro em caso de acidente, e ou problemas de saúde, realizar integração / DSS com sua equipe;

Elaborar planos operacionais, colaborando com sugestões, fazendo mudanças de funções , delegando atividades e supervisionando o trabalho das equipes;

Desenvolver a sua equipe de maneira a promover o crescimento profissional e intelectual de cada membro.

title: SAP BTP Fiori
description:
We're hiring: SAP BTP – Remote Opportunity

Are you experienced in building scalable SAP solutions and passionate about working on global projects? We're looking for a skilled professional to join a U.S.-based team and contribute to high-impact initiatives.


Key Requirements:

  • Hands-on experience with SAP BTP
  • Strong background in SAP Fiori application design, development, and support
  • Solid understanding of SAP Workflow , ABAP , SAP Basis , and Authorization concepts
  • Proficiency in SAP ODATA Framework , OOABAP , and Git
  • Experience with REST APIs , OData services , and CAPM
  • Front-end development skills: JavaScript , XML , HTML5 , CSS3 , JSON
  • Familiarity with Eclipse IDE , SAP Web IDE , and UI Theme Designer
  • Good verbal and written communication skills
  • Flexibility to work in shifts and support go-live activities on weekends when needed


This is a great opportunity to work remotely, collaborate with international teams, and grow your career in a dynamic environment.


If you're interested, please send your updated resume in English and we'll take it from there!

title: Freelance Data Analyst, Social + Paid Media
description:
Position Summary

The social + media data analyst role is responsible for pulling, transforming, and analyzing data sets (from organic social/media/website/campaign) to provide actionable insights and aid with data-driven strategies. The role will be responsible for the development of forward-thinking insights derived from social media data (tools like Sprout, Brandwatch, and native platform), digital/paid media data, publisher reporting, and social listening tools to help guide strategy and creative, as well as contributing to the development of the holistic measurement approach for assigned clients and projects.


This is a remote, international contract role with the ability to work for up to 6 months.


Pay range is R$7.000 - $9.000/month.


Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Identify and ensure alignment on key performance indicators for organic social and paid media campaigns
  • Develop and execute monitoring and measurement plans based on objectives and agreed-upon KPIs
  • Gather data from third-party tools as well as owned channels and native platforms to generate ongoing performance reports and dashboards
  • Analyze data sets (social media–organic/paid, paid media, etc.) to pull actionable insights and help evolve the overall social and media strategies
  • Structure and analyze informative reports and dashboards to aid organic social teams and digital/paid media teams in campaign optimizations
  • Work with publishing partners to structure reporting cadences and delivery dates
  • Collaborate across departments to communicate insights and findings
  • Present key findings and insights to clients throughout reporting cycles


Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • 1-3 years of professional work experience within an agency or brand setting
  • Must have a background in analyzing data (social media, media, website) and generating reports, as well as using social listening and monitoring tools to derive insights
  • Ability to translate your research & observations into clear, insightful and visually stimulating presentations that tell a compelling story
  • Ability to clearly and convincingly present findings and insights in a way that demonstrates the value of the data and analysis to clients

title: Medical Writer Subject Matter Expert
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider of choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel, and Germany. We’re poised for a period of explosive growth over the next few years.

About the Role:

At Innodata, we’re working with the world’s largest technology companies on the next generation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We’re looking for smart, savvy, and curious subject matter experts.

We are seeking a Medical Writer Subject Matter Expert with exceptional writing and analytical skills to join our AI/ML data team. In this role, you will help train advanced Large Language Models (LLMs) by producing, curating, and reviewing high-quality medical and scientific content. Your expertise will directly shape the way AI systems understand, explain, and communicate clinical and biomedical information.

Key Responsibilities:

Create high-quality, accurate, and medically sound content, including:

  • Clinical and scientific explanations of medical topics
  • Research summaries, clinical abstracts, and literature reviews
  • Patient education materials
  • Medical problem sets, case studies, and evidence-based Q&A
  • Regulatory, pharmacological, or public health-focused content (as applicable)

Collaborate with AI researchers and engineers to:

  • Review and refine medical-related model outputs
  • Identify and address conceptual gaps in LLM training data
  • Build diverse datasets across medical and healthcare domains (e.g., anatomy, pathology, pharmacology, public health, epidemiology, evidence-based medicine)
  • Provide feedback to improve LLM performance in reasoning, comprehension, and communication of healthcare content

Eligibility Criteria:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Medicine, Biomedical Sciences, Pharmacy, Public Health, or a related healthcare/clinical discipline
  • (Exceptional candidates with professional degrees such as MD, DO, PharmD, MPH, or equivalent clinical experience will be considered)
  • Strong background in medical/scientific writing, with the ability to communicate complex topics clearly and accurately
  • Experience with literature review, evidence synthesis, or regulatory writing is a plus
  • Familiarity with scientific publishing standards, citation practices, and biomedical databases (e.g., PubMed, Cochrane)

Additional Requirement:

As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment.

This assessment is mandatory and non-billable.

Com mais de 35 anos de mercado e localizada em 16 países, a GFT emprega mais de 10.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo 3.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

O que estamos buscando?


Engenharia de Dados Pleno


Requisitos:

Experiência avançada em AWS e seus principais serviços para engenharia de dados (S3, Glue, Lambda, Redshift, DynamoDB, Athena, etc.). Domínio de linguagens de programação como Python para manipulação e processamento de dados. Conhecimento de ferramentas de orquestração de dados, como Apache Airflow ou AWS Step Functions.

Experiência em banco de dados relacional e não relacional (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB).

Familiaridade com boas práticas de segurança em ambientes AWS (IAM, KMS, criptografia de dados). Experiência em soluções de streaming de dados (Kafka, Kinesis).

Conhecimento em controle de versão e pipelines de CI/CD utilizando ferramentas como GitHub, Jenkins, ou CodePipeline.

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;

title: Assistente administrativo
description:
Administrative Assistant – 100% Remote


About us:

We are a technology company operating in Brazil and abroad, providing innovative business management solutions. We are looking for an Administrative Assistant to join our team and support the company’s financial and administrative operations.


Responsibilities:

  • Issue and control invoices (domestic and international)
  • Manage accounts payable and receivable
  • Monitor and maintain client and supplier contracts
  • Support daily administrative routines
  • Collaborate with internal teams and interface with external partners


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or Accounting
  • Previous experience in financial and administrative routines
  • Fluent English (mandatory)
  • Knowledge of management tools (ERP, spreadsheets, and reports)
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and proactivity


What we offer:

  • 100% remote work (Time zone Brasília)
  • A dynamic and innovative work environment
  • Growth opportunities in an international company
  • Competitive compensation package

title: Supply Chain - Solution Consultant & Business Consultant (Forecasting & Replenishment)
description:
Supply Chain - Solution Consultant & Business Consultant (Forecasting & Replenishment)  

Location: (Remote) 

Employment: Full-time


As a Supply Chain Consultant, you will be integral to delivering and executing projects for the Relex Forecasting & Replenishment solution, as well as other Relex offerings. This role requires close collaboration with client executives and IT teams to design and implement tailored supply chain solutions that drive measurable business results. 

Business advisory for Retailers, distributors and producers in Latin America, USA, EMEA. 


Responsibilities


Project Execution:  

  • Understanding and determining business requirements and the desired future state of clients’ operations. 
  • Configuring RELEX tools according to customer specifications. 
  • Managing platform configuration, data handling, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT). 
  • Attending or leading process development workshops. Conducting design workshops. 
  • Analyzing data, business processes and KPIs. 
  • Presenting findings and results to both operational teams and executive stakeholders. 
  • Creating and maintaining Functional Design Documents, including process maps and UI workflow designs. 
  • Educating and training customers to use RELEX effectively, and providing ongoing user support. 
  • Tracking KPIs to ensure the business case is achieved and the solution is properly adopted. 

Sales Support:  

  • Assist in preparing proposals, project scopes, plans, and solution architectures. 
  • Conduct product demonstrations and prepare sales materials such as presentations and success stories. 
  • Participate in sales meetings and support business development activities. 

Solution Consulting:  

  • Support system definitions, configuration, and early rollout support aligned with project requirements. 
  • Facilitate client workshops by preparing agendas, content, and follow-up actions. 
  • Engage in ongoing training to deepen technical expertise. 


Additional Activities:  

  • Attend relevant industry events and company training sessions. 
  • Contribute to general sales, administrative tasks, and knowledge sharing within the team. 
  • Occasional travel may be required to support project activities. 



Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain, Software/Systems Administration, Business Administration. 
  • Proven experience in forecasting and replenishment, preferably with RELEX or similar SCM solutions. 
  • Desired certifications and knowledge: SCM, CPIM, CSCP, and digital supply chain applications. 
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in Portuguese and English . Spanish would be differentiator.
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to translate business needs into technical solutions. 
  • Ability to work remotely with cross-cultural teams and client stakeholders.
